episodes.title: Gordon B  Hinckley on CNN's Larry King Live
episodes.description:
On September 8, 1998, the prophet of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints, Gordon B. Hinckley, appeared on CNN's Larry King Live. I am posting the episode in its entirety for the historical record. 

For the full transcript, visit here: https://lds-mormon.com/lkl_00-shtml/

___________________

Welcome to Analyzing Mormonism! My aim is to help teach accurate Church history and to help my listeners become, in many ways, Mormon historians.

episodes.title: Zen Master Rama 4 - Larry King Live Expose
episodes.description:
This is a piece from Larry King Live on Zen Master Rama, aka Atmandana, aka Frederick Lenz, noted computer guru and "American Buddhism" cult leader.

Frederick Lenz/Zen Master Rama died in 1998 at the age of 48.

This video is offered for educational purposes only.  No infringement is intended.
